notes: cachedInput is the cache-read (hit) price; cacheWrite is the cache-creation price. Both are charged separately from uncached input.

reasoning null means reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens and are already counted inside outputTokens (true for both providers here). Set a number only if a provider bills reasoning at a different rate.
cacheWrite uses the 5-minute TTL rate. Turn usage does not record the cache TTL; if a provider writes 1-hour caches, switch to cacheWrite1h and say so in the report.
Entries with verify: true must be checked against the provider's public price page before the scored run. report.ts marks every cost as provisional while any priced model is unverified.

claude-opus-5-5.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Claude Opus 5.5 row; cache hits are 0.05x base input)
